blocked_reasons: The current station remains provider-native CV1_3600; TWCOMP3 is an old archive/config alias and does not rename it. All six TWCOMP3 raw/map pairs reproduce the pinned TW/base.yaml display rule pixel-for-pixel, and the pinned parser uses its country fallback when a station-specific rule is absent. The local archive does not bind these pairs to a particular current collector path (tw-http versus anonymous-S3 tw), so they provide country-level rule evidence but remain unassigned to tw-http; their 3600x3600 image pairs also do not establish a legacy gray path for tw/grid.
